issues.problem: Renderer-density coupling is a module-global singleton (last DashDensity constructed wins) and 'training' is inferred from torch.is_grad_enabled(). Cannot misfire in the supported flows (ss-train builds once; end-of-train measure() and ss-eval are no_grad and ss-eval's fresh build has schedule_active=False; final scale is 1 after 27000), and before_backward raises on any size/scale desync. It could mis-scale a grad-enabled render in the same process after a second build or concurrent runs.
issues.evidence: link.py Link.attach in DashDensity.__init__; renderer.py scale = LINK.training_scale() if torch.is_grad_enabled() else 1; density.before_backward guard
issues.fix: Optional hardening: have density.before_backward be the only consumer (already guarded), and reset LINK.density=None at end of training or when a new density is built while another is active; never run two trainings interleaved in one process.

issues.problem: Dataset identity is cross-checked only through train-view count, W/H, K and viewmat. The dataset protocol_id/sha is not compared with the runtime's, and no probe has a negative case (mismatched root/downscale raises; test frames are never read as images). Data root comes from sys.argv if config 'data' is unset, so a non-ss-train launcher fails loudly (RuntimeError) rather than silently.
issues.evidence: density.py: names = dataset['splits']['train']; allclose(K), allclose(viewmat) per view; no dataset['protocol_id'] check; probes.py has no negative reload test
issues.fix: Optional: also verify the reloaded splits['train'] list equals the runtime list by name via a hash, and add a probe that a differing downscale or a test-frame name raises.

issues.problem: 17.27 matches paper Table 1/2 (Deep Blending 3DGS row) but the mean of the supplementary Table 8 per-scene times (19.47, 17.27) is 18.37. The paper is internally inconsistent; the value 17.27 coincides with the playroom time.
issues.fix: Annotate in paper_results.json that Table 2 reports 17.27 while Table 8 per-scene mean is 18.37; compare speed-ups per scene, not via that average.

issues.problem: total_steps (position-LR horizon, 30000) is a fixed config value, not tied to the ss-train --steps; only matters for non-30000 runs (benchmarks use 30000).
issues.fix: Document; compressed smoke runs must pass it explicitly.

issues.problem: Shared runtime differences vs official (white background so the official white-bg opacity reset at step 500 is absent; random view sampling with replacement; valid-conv SSIM; gsplat rasterizer) are inherited, not introduced by the plugin. Bench must use --recipe 3dgs --num-gaussians 10000000 because P_fin = 6*P_init depends on the SfM point count (README line 55 states this; bench_request.json 'extra' is empty so bench.py defaults must supply it).
issues.evidence: runtime.initial_points caps points at --num-gaussians (default 10000); CLAUDE.md protocol note
issues.fix: Confirm the bench run command includes --num-gaussians 10000000 before launching.

fidelity_gaps_confirmed: Training-split-only reload: names = dataset['splits']['train'] from splatstudio.data.load_dataset (same llffhold8 protocol and downscale as runtime; test/validation images are loaded into RAM by load_dataset but never read or passed to the scheduler; FFT sees only train images). Per-view K/viewmat/size cross-check raises on any mismatch. Nothing from test images reaches training.
Schedule numerics match official schedule_utils.py line by line (centre (h+1)//2, int(h/r)//2 half-window, 64-step bisection, per-view min r_m, mean spectrum, begins via ln ratios).

Render size floor(H/r) with K row scaled by w/W, h/H equals official fixed tan(fov) + render_size; principal point scales to w/2 for centred cx. Densify gradient normalised by reduced width/height as 3DGS.

densify_until 27000 with refine at 600..26900 and opacity reset at 3000..24000 (inside step<27000) match train_dash.py/full_eval.py --dash; prune-first, top-k clone/split, no screen-size pruning, P_add = count(grads>=thr) after prune, as official.
Evaluation (measure) runs under no_grad and always at full resolution; ss-eval builds a fresh inactive link.

paper_results.json: every per-scene and average value for 3DGS and 3DGS +Ours (PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, time, N_GS) matches supplementary Tables 7, 8, 9 and the recomputed averages, with the single Table 2 vs Table 8 time inconsistency noted above.
summary: No critical or major issues. Training-image reload is train-split-only with the runtime's load_dataset/llffhold8/downscale and a strict camera cross-check; schedules, loss, renderer scaling, densification, momentum, LR and reset/densify horizons match the official code. Only minor hardening and documentation items remain.
